nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: A moving average approach was used to obtain the unbiased mean and variance estimates for the GFA metric in each age range to construct sex-specific normative age models. This is a nonparametric smoothing approach similar to LOESS.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: A moving average approach was used to obtain the unbiased mean and variance estimates for the GFA metric in each age range.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Chien2022.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Statistical analysis, standardized normative models

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Generalized fractional anisotropy (GFA) of 45 major white matter tracts was used as the response variable. GFA provides a broad measure of WM axonal health in the DSI framework, computed via mean-apparent propagator models.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: The diffusion profiles of each person included GFA of 45 major WM tracts, predefined on an open-sourced DSI template through deterministic streamline-based tractography. GFA, providing a broad measure of WM axonal health in the DSI framework, was computed via mean-apparent propagator models
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Chien2022.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Image acquisition and analysis

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used to define normative ranges in sex-specific age models.
